CT-24f / BR-ID-36 细则「规则清单的启停」: GET /admin/v1/risk-rules (config.risk, read only, per app, scene then rule_id, catalog name / threshold_keys with fallback), POST /admin/v1/risk-rules/{rule_id}/enable|disable (config.risk + totp step-up every call; CAS on version and app_id inside SQL; already in the target state with a matching version → unchanged, no audit; otherwise version + 1 and one audit record; reason optional 1–200). Lands after GATE-RISK-RULE-TOGGLE (B1-03zh #2157 rule-status reader at identity / growth / risk, B1-09m orders, B2-11f payout blocklist per dimension): a disabled rule now neither judges nor writes risk_hits at every decision point, so the console toggle takes effect within the config cache cycle (r1 S1 resolved there). The round-2 commit of this branch moved to B1-03zh per D10-536 and was dropped here; rebased onto main. Removes x-implementation planned of the three operations; generated files regenerated. Full verification is the required CI checks (approvals 21; AWS runners off, D10-555).
